knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r import_data}
library(tidyverse)

if (file.exists("../data/processed/analysis_data.rds")) {
  project_root <- ".."
} else if (file.exists("data/processed/analysis_data.rds")) {
  project_root <- "."
} else {
  stop("Cannot find data/processed/analysis_data.rds. Check the working directory and Stage 2 output.")
}

input_file <- file.path(project_root, "data", "processed", "analysis_data.rds")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "figures")
tables_dir <- file.path(project_root, "tables")

dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tables_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

analysis_data <- readRDS(input_file)
cat("Project root:", normalizePath(project_root), "\n")
cat("Input dataset:", normalizePath(input_file), "\n")

dim(analysis_data)
glimpse(analysis_data)

cat("Person records:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")
cat("Distinct households:", n_distinct(analysis_data$HOUSEID), "\n")
cat("Duplicate person-key index (expect 0):", anyDuplicated(
  analysis_data[c("HOUSEID", "PERSONID")]
), "\n")
```

### Confirm required columns and valid outcome values

```{r validate_variables}
required_vars <- c(
  "HOUSEID",
  "PERSONID",
  "mean_trip_miles",
  "density_band",
  "age",
  "worker",
  "hh_size",
  "vehicles",
  "car_group",
  "day_of_week",
  "person_weight"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_vars %in% names(analysis_data))
)
stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(analysis_data$mean_trip_miles)),
  all(analysis_data$mean_trip_miles >= 0),
  !anyNA(analysis_data$density_band)
)
```


```{r step_18_1}
y_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    households = n_distinct(HOUSEID),
    mean_miles = mean(mean_trip_miles),
    median_miles = median(mean_trip_miles),
    sd_miles = sd(mean_trip_miles),
    min_miles = min(mean_trip_miles),
    q1_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.25
    ),
    q3_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.75
    ),
    p95_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.95
    ),
    p99_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.99
    ),
    max_miles = max(mean_trip_miles),
    zero_n = sum(mean_trip_miles == 0),
    zero_pct = 100 * mean(
      mean_trip_miles == 0
    )
  )
print(y_summary, width = Inf)
```


```{r step_18_1_quantiles}
quantile(
  analysis_data$mean_trip_miles,
  probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99)
)
```


```{r step_18_2}
continuous_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  select(
    mean_trip_miles,
    age,
    hh_size,
    vehicles
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(
      value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    q3 = quantile(
      value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(continuous_summary)
```


```{r step_18_3_worker}
worker_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  count(worker) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )
print(worker_summary)
```


```{r step_18_3_car}
car_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  count(car_group) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )
print(car_summary)
```


```{r step_18_3_weekday}
day_summary <- analysis_data %>%

  )
print(day_summary)
```

## Step 19 - Descriptive statistics by residential density

### Step 19.1 - Count travellers by population-density category

```{r step_19_1}
density_count <- analysis_data %>%
  count(density_band, name = "persons") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * persons / sum(persons)
  )
print(density_count)
sum(density_count$persons)
expected_count <- c(
  1139, 1330, 772, 1272,
  1916, 1920, 438, 265
)
data.frame(
  density_band = density_count$density_band,
  actual = density_count$persons,
  expected = expected_count,
  difference = density_count$persons - expected_count
)
```

### Step 19.2 - Compare trip distance across density bands

```{r step_19_2}
density_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(density_band) %>%
  summarise(
    persons = n(),
    households = n_distinct(HOUSEID),
    mean_miles = mean(mean_trip_miles),
    median_miles = median(mean_trip_miles),
    sd_miles = sd(mean_trip_miles),
    q1_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.25
    ),
    q3_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.75
    ),
    p95_miles = quantile(
      mean_trip_miles, 0.95
    ),
    zero_n = sum(mean_trip_miles == 0),
    zero_pct = 100 * mean(
      mean_trip_miles == 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_pct = 100 * persons / sum(persons)
  )
print(density_summary, width = Inf)
```

```{r step_19_3}
zero_by_density <- density_summary %>%
  select(
    density_band,
    persons,
    zero_n,
    zero_pct
  )
print(zero_by_density)
```


```{r step_19_weighted}
weighted_density_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(density_band) %>%
  summarise(
    unweighted_mean = mean(mean_trip_miles),
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(
      mean_trip_miles,
      w = person_weight
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(weighted_density_summary)
```


```{r step_20_1}
p_hist_full <- ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(x = mean_trip_miles)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 60,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Mean Trip Distance",
    subtitle = "2022 NHTS adult travellers",
    x = "Mean trip distance (miles)",
    y = "Number of travellers",
    caption = "Source: 2022 NextGen NHTS V2.1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
print(p_hist_full)
```

### Step 20.2 - Zoom the histogram to 0-60 miles

```{r step_20_2}
p_hist_zoom <- ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(x = mean_trip_miles)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2,
    boundary = 0,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0, 60)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Trip Distance: 0–60 Miles",
    x = "Mean trip distance (miles)",
    y = "Number of travellers",
    caption = paste(
      "Display restricted to 0–60 miles.",
      "Observations outside this range",
      "remain in the analysis dataset."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
print(p_hist_zoom)
```


```{r illustration_filter_only, eval=FALSE}
analysis_data %>%
  filter(mean_trip_miles <= 60)
```


```{r step_20_2_outside}
analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_above_60 = sum(mean_trip_miles > 60),
    pct_above_60 = 100 * mean(
      mean_trip_miles > 60
    )
  )
```

### Step 20.3 - Histogram of log(1 + mean trip miles)

```{r step_20_3}
p_hist_log <- ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(x = log1p(mean_trip_miles))
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Log-Transformed Trip Distance",
    subtitle = "Using ln(1 + miles)",
    x = "ln(1 + mean trip distance in miles)",
    y = "Number of travellers"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
print(p_hist_log)
```


```{r export_figure_1}
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figures_dir, "Figure_1a_full_distribution.png"),

  dpi = 300
)
ggsave(

  plot = p_hist_zoom,
  width = 8,

  dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figures_dir, "Figure_1c_log_distribution.png"),

)
```

```{r step_21_labels}
density_labels <- c(
  "01" = "0–99",
  "02" = "100–499",
  "03" = "500–999",
  "04" = "1,000–1,999",
  "05" = "2,000–3,999",
  "06" = "4,000–9,999",
  "07" = "10,000–24,999",
  "08" = "25,000+"
)
```


```{r step_21_1}
p_density_box <- ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(
    x = density_band,
    y = mean_trip_miles
  )
) +
  # Box = IQR, central line = median; points beyond whiskers are shown as outliers.
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.alpha = 0.15,
    outlier.size = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 60)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = density_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Trip Distance by Residential Population Density",
    subtitle = "Adult travellers in the 2022 NHTS",
    x = "Population density (persons per sq. mile)",
    y = "Mean trip distance (miles)",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: 2022 NextGen NHTS V2.1.",
      "Vertical display limited to 0–60 miles."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
print(p_density_box)
```


```{r step_21_2}
p_density_log_box <- ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(
    x = density_band,
    y = log1p(mean_trip_miles)
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.alpha = 0.15,
    outlier.size = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = density_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trip Distance by Population Density",
    subtitle = "Log-transformed mean trip distance",
    x = "Population density (persons per sq. mile)",
    y = "ln(1 + mean trip distance in miles)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
print(p_density_log_box)
```


```{r step_21_3}
density_compare <- density_summary %>%
  select(
    density_band,
    mean_miles,
    median_miles
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_miles, median_miles),
    names_to = "statistic",
    values_to = "distance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = recode(
      statistic,
      mean_miles = "Mean",
      median_miles = "Median"
    )
  )

p_density_compare <- ggplot(
  density_compare,
  aes(
    x = density_band,
    y = distance,
    colour = statistic
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = density_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean and Median Trip Distance by Density",
    x = "Population density (persons per sq. mile)",
    y = "Trip distance (miles)",
    colour = "Statistic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
print(p_density_compare)
```

```{r step_22_2}
car_density_count <- analysis_data %>%
  count(
    density_band,
    car_group,
    .drop = FALSE,
    name = "n"
  )
car_density_table <- car_density_count %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = car_group,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
print(car_density_table)
```

```{r step_22_2_heatmap}
car_density_count <- car_density_count %>%
  mutate(
    text_colour = if_else(
      n < 650, "white", "black"
    )
  )

p_car_heatmap <- ggplot(
  car_density_count,
  aes(
    x = density_band,
    y = car_group,
    fill = n
  )
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n, colour = text_colour),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = density_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Counts by Density and Vehicle Ownership",
    x = "Population density (persons per sq. mile)",
    y = "Number of household vehicles",
    fill = "Persons",
    caption = "Counts represent adult travellers, not distinct households."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

print(p_car_heatmap)
```

### Step 22.3 - Weekday-specific trip distance summaries

```{r step_22_3}
weekday_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(day_of_week) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_miles = mean(mean_trip_miles),
    median_miles = median(mean_trip_miles),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(weekday_summary)
```

### Step 22.3 - Bar chart of weekday medians

```{r step_22_3_plot}
p_weekday <- ggplot(
  weekday_summary,
  aes(
    x = day_of_week,
    y = median_miles
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Median Trip Distance by Day of Week",
    x = "Survey day",
    y = "Median trip distance (miles)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
print(p_weekday)
```
